network_state: Three regional contract areas and two town networks

Novojičínsko Východ (licences 883xxx, Z-Group bus, Kopřivnice), Novojičínsko Západ (882xxx) and Bílovecko (884xxx) of Transdev Morava; the town lines of Nový Jičín (886xxx, ARRIVA autobusy) and Studénka (887611, Transdev Morava). Lines holding licences in two areas are shown under the area with most of their trips.
Diversion timetables to the end of the timetable year

The CIS JŘ export has diversion versions valid on the vehicle day until 11–12 Dec 2026 for 286, 623, 641 (via Příbor, Štramberská), 662, 673 (Březová, škola instead of Březová, střed), 679, 692 and 693. They run until the timetable change, so they are modelled as they run.

629 (to 3 Dec) and 929 (to 12 Nov) only move times; 643 (16 – 31 Oct) runs via Příbor, Štramberská. They end before the timetable change, so the regular timetables are modelled (shared rule: short works as the regular state).

351, 355, 980 and 985 hold a few trips on Novojičínsko licences but are Frýdecko-Místecko lines, on the Těšínsko/Třinecko/Frýdecko sheet. 261, 263, 270, 285 and 678 are modelled on the Opavsko/Vítkovsko/Hlučínsko sheet, where most of their trips are. 655 is modelled here: 41 of its 45 trips are on the Novojičínsko licence.

texts.eyebrow: ODIS regional and town buses · Novojičínsko Východ · Novojičínsko Západ · Bílovecko · MHD Nový Jičín · Studénka · vypravenost
texts.lede_who: The ODIS bus lines of three regional contract areas (Novojičínsko Východ, Z-Group bus; Novojičínsko Západ and Bílovecko, Transdev Morava) and the town lines of Nový Jičín (ARRIVA autobusy) and Studénka (Transdev Morava)
texts.swap_places: Nový Jičín, Kopřivnice, Frenštát, Bílovec and Ostrava-Svinov
texts.scope: Licences with the area prefixes 883 (Novojičínsko Východ, Z-Group bus), 882 (Novojičínsko Západ) and 884 (Bílovecko) of Transdev Morava, 886 (MHD Nový Jičín, ARRIVA autobusy) and 887 (Studénka, Transdev Morava)
texts.scope_check: The prefixes match the live map (Z-Group pr. Kopřivnice with 63- buses; Transdev Morava pr. Nový Jičín 62- and pr. Ostrava 64-; ARRIVA Nový Jičín) and the kraj's contract areas (Novojičínsko Východ, Novojičínsko Západ, Bílovecko).
texts.buses_extra: Fleet numbers and types come from the seznam-autobusu registers of Z-Group bus and Transdev Morava; ARRIVA's town buses and a few unlisted plates were looked up one by one (01b_plates.py).
texts.depots: Z-Group bus Kopřivnice, Transdev Morava Nový Jičín and Ostrava branches, and ARRIVA's Nový Jičín garage. A seen bus counts at the branch the live map reports for it; a designed bus at its home branch.
texts.unmodelled_intro: Shift lines and sparse lines whose stops other lines already serve (method Step 8: a long-interval line only where it is a place’s only service), the Nový Jičín town lines that run as one circuit (602, 603, 604 in 601–604), and lines with no afternoon trips.

pak.why: VZ-ODIS-bus holds the ODIS regional fleet; Transdev Morava's white with the red Transdev logo is transdev, Z-Group's white with the kraj logo bila, BORS Břeclav's yellow-blue borszlutomodra. The Nový Jičín and Studénka town buses take their town packages. Objects confirmed by the pak fleet desk on 21 Oct 2026; the Z-Group-livery Crossway LE Line (21 Oct) and ARRIVA's red-black SOR BN 10,5 no. 7577 (22 Oct; its layout is unverified, as no photo after the 2025 repaint exists) were drawn for this sheet.
